description: One insight at the moment is that static ads seem to be converting better on average than video.. could this be down to AI UGC? #metaads #facebookads #ecommerce #business #entrepreneur
transcript: And what I can tell you right now is that across all of the ad accounts that I've been working on for the last 90 days, static is starting to perform better than video. I think what's happening is that there are too many brands that are doing bad AI content, and a lot of consumers are becoming skeptical of whether the creative that they are watching is AI generated. So in my opinion, I think there's a lack of trust that's starting to happen with video creators. And on top of that, a lot of brands are just going with this generic influencer voice like your standard UGC creator, which isn't converting as well versus static. That is the trend I'm seeing. But either way, you should have variation here.
